purpose: Expand question-only classification from selected 120 cases / 24 diseases to all 49 diseases and the entire official test split.
training: Nested uniform reservoir samples from official train.csv, up to 500 cases per disease; no age or evidence-count exclusions. Also retain the frozen old 120-case model as a separate 24-class experiment.
test: All official test.csv rows, with separate metrics excluding exact training fact sets and excluding seen question inventories. Previously analyzed test IDs flagged.
model: RidgeClassifier(alpha=1, solver=lsqr); vocabulary and TF-IDF fitted on training only. No hyperparameter search on test.
audits: cross-split exact fact duplicates ignoring demographics
within-test conflicting labels under identical question inventory
interpretation: Same-generator generalization, not external clinical validation. Presence of a binary evidence in raw EVIDENCES already implies a positive finding. Test-set inventory purity is a descriptive finite-sample ceiling, not estimated out-of-sample accuracy. Dropping evidence is a synthetic missingness stress test, not a simulated clinical interview.
cost: Local CPU only; no paid API or large language model calls.
